'''June 2000 Clear Lake tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Clear Lake, Iowa on 24 June 2000. [[Seth Van Winkle]] won it. It is known from Seth Van Winkle's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d950">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-28-clear-lake-iowa-6-24-00d950/ clear-lake-iowa-6-24-00], DeckTech (Seth "Ooryl" Van Winkle, 28 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-28-clear-lake-iowa-6-24-00d950/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Clear Lake, Iowa
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 13
* '''Winner:''' [[Seth Van Winkle]]
